profile.headline: engineering exquisite software
profile.summary:
Creative and resourceful leader with background in Scrum, Web Development, Visual Design & Interaction, Product Development.

20+ years focused on designing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise level Web solutions and leading critical projects. Tenacious problem solver.

positions.title: Manager, Cloud Cost Engineering
positions.description: Cost reduction, forecasting, and optimization of $20M+ AWS spend.  Heavily rely on EC2, EFS, FSx, S3, RDS, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, EBS.  Develop custom solutions for engineering needs.

positions.title: Manager Software Engineering
positions.description: Lead development group on various size projects typically running in parallel. Entire project life-cycle starting with business requirements and translating business needs into technical requirements, working with product and analysts on functional requirements, proposing and reviewing technical design documents, coordinating implementation via agile/scrum, tracking project progress, resource allocation and planning. In my role I work closely with other, usually geographically distributed, software development groups, teams and resources.

positions.title: Lead Internet Technologist
positions.description: Responsible for operations and technology of high profile Web site.  Launched e-com storefront.  Created XML/XSL-based synchronization system with AS/400.   -33% per-sale fixed costs, -10% site expenses, +90% paid subscriptions, -90% customer support (problem) tickets

positions.title: Solutions Consultant
positions.description: Led discovery with clients & executive team Approved/wrote creative briefs, functional specs, technical designs, etc.   Mentored programmers, UX designers, IT staff.  Interviewed and evaluated job candidates.   Managed 20+ person team to create a vertical B2B exchange for an established Internet company. Chaired Technical Steering Committee to institute corporate policies and best practices  Launched certification initiative to become Microsoft Solution Provider.  Clients included A&E, The History Channel, Museumshop, BBB, Ryder, YMHA.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Built and marketed an innovative, customer-centric e-commerce Internet property from concept to final product launch, running on a fully-automated and outsourced, zero inventory model.  Designed and launched the Webs 2nd largest (36,000+) magazine affiliate program.  Attracted the interest of Amazon.com, Blue Mountain Arts, Mail.com, Mindseye Technologies, and Swets & Zeitlinger as potential investors, strategic partners, and/or acquirers.  
	Closed initial $100,000 seed round of financing
	Attracted $5,000,000 round of financing (terms never agreed to; $12.5M post-money valuation)
	Became 3rd largest Internet subscription site, behind E-News and Publishers Clearinghouse
	Featured in The Boston Globe, E-Commerce Times, Massachusetts High Tech, Wall Street Journal

projects.title: Northern Virginia Technical Council (NVTC) Veterans Employment Initiative
projects.description:
The Northern Virginia Technology Council (NVTC) is the largest technology council in the nation and the voice of the technology community in Northern Virginia. Many NVTC member companies consider finding qualified employees difficult and believe overall workforce development is one of the greatest long-term challenges facing our technology community.

The NVTC Veterans Employment Initiative is a program connecting the veteran, to employment opportunities within Virginia's technology community. Through this initiative, NVTC is providing tools and resources to match military veterans with internships, jobs, mentorships and certifications, while also providing support to NVTC member companies in their efforts to hire, train and retain qualified veteran employees.

This online community, developed by NVTC and Monster.com, provides a searchable database of jobs at NVTC member companies, a military skills translator for veterans to match their skills to jobs in the civilian environment, and educational resources and tools, all designed to facilitate veterans’ transition into the civilian workforce.
